subject: Pilot kickoff — operational checklist, success metrics, owners
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Nolan <j.nolan@datumworks.co>, Kira Patel <kira.patel@datumworks.co>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot kickoff — operational checklist, success metrics, owners

Hi James / Kira,

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan to hit a 4-week pilot. I pulled together a lightweight operational checklist and an initial success-metrics doc (attached).

Key outcomes from discovery:
- Primary eval goal: reduce latency on retrieval-augmented responses and improve top-3 answer relevance for user support flows.
- Success metric targets: median inference latency < 220ms for 8k-context requests; top-3 relevancy lift +18% measured on the provided gold set.
- Data: you can share a de-identified sample set (5000 rows) for initial tuning.

Proposed pilot plan (4 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): scope & SOW sign-off (SOW draft attached) — owners: James (confirm data sharing), Hannah (SOW & timeline), Aditya (commercial).
2) Week 1: onboarding & baseline capture — Redwood sets up private trial instance and we run baseline evals. Owner: Marissa.
3) Week 2: model tuning & config (batching, caching rules, quantization guidance) — owners: Redwood infra + DatumWorks ML.
4) Week 3: acceptance run, QA, synthetic traffic, and final readout prep — owners: Hannah + Marissa.

Immediate asks:
- James: confirm you can share the de-identified sample by EOD Thu (SLA will depend on having that dataset).
- Kira: please review the success-metrics doc and call out any missing KPIs we should include.
- Aditya / Marissa (internal): I’ve attached the operational checklist and SOW v0.3; Aditya, flag any commercial changes before I send formal SOW. Marissa, please prep baseline runbook.

Attachments: Trial-Operational-Checklist.xlsx, POC-Success-Metrics.docx, SOW_v0.3.pdf

Thanks — proposed follow-up: 30-minute kickoff Tue 12/7 at 10am PT. If that works, I’ll send calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: James Nolan <j.nolan@datumworks.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kira Patel <kira.patel@datumworks.co>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — operational checklist, success metrics, owners

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick clarifications:
1) Data: we can share a de-identified 5k sample by Friday morning — I’ll assign an engineer.
2) KPIs: we’d also love to track 95th percentile latency (very important for our mobile clients). Can you add that to the success doc?
3) SOW: we’ll review and get back on the commercial items; expect comments by Mon.

Call time on 12/7 looks good for me — tentatively accepted.

—James
James Nolan
VP Product | DatumWorks
j.nolan@datumworks.co

Thanks, James — yes on all three. I updated the success doc to include 95th percentile latency and added a short measurement method section (see attached POC-Success-Metrics.docx v1.1).

Operational owners & near-term asks (updated):
- Data transfer: James to confirm by Fri, 12/4.
- Baseline runbook: Marissa to coordinate with DatumWorks infra and share playbook (Marissa: target Mon 12/6).
- SOW feedback: Aditya to collect internal pricing feedback; ready for legal review by Tue 12/7.

I also created a stub HubSpot deal (link below) and will attach calendar invite for 12/7 10am PT.

Hannah

Aditya here — SOW_v0.3 attached. Two commercial notes:
- We’re holding the promotional pilot rate through Dec if we get signed SOW before Dec 15.
- If DatumWorks needs additional dedicated capacity beyond the pilot, we should scope in Week 2 for a capacity trial addendum.

James — if you can flag any commercial redlines by Tue 12/7 EOD we’ll incorporate and send to legal. Otherwise we’ll assume the timeline for signature.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot kickoff — operational checklist, success metrics, owners (weekly nudge)

Hey team — small weekly status & next-steps nudge before our 12/14 readout:
- DatumWorks: thank you for the sample data (received 12/4). Baseline run started on 12/6; initial metrics expected Mon 12/15.
- Redwood: baseline capture completed for retrieval pipeline; I’ve attached the updated Trial-Operational-Checklist with timestamps and owner checkboxes completed through Week 1.
- Open items for DatumWorks: please confirm the API key rotation schedule and whether mobile simulator will be available for synthetic 95th percentile runs (requested by 12/16).

Next actions:
- Marissa: finalize baseline report and circulate to this thread by 12/15 (owner: Marissa).
- Hannah / Aditya: finalize SOW w/ any redlines from DatumWorks; target legal submission by 12/16.
- James / Kira: confirm API rotation window and simulator availability by 12/16.

One-line from James included below (got as a DM):
> Looks good — we’ll confirm simulator availability Monday.

Thanks everyone — short check-in on Tue 12/14 at 10am PT (calendar invite sent).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
